name: dev-workflows
description: Six slash commands for the implementation half of the product lifecycle: `/design` turns a specification into a design, with Opus review and an optional three-take fan-out on a contested interface. `/implement` builds it with one code writer and one test writer, gated by Opus plan critique and code review after tests. `/ready` verifies an ARD/spec/design chain's readiness, read-only, no tracker read. `/conformance` traces every requirement against an Epic's branch, or each repository's default branch, and records how each discrepancy is settled. `/upgrade` plans and executes dependency upgrades; `/vuln` researches and fixes a CVE. Fourteen subagents, one hook, twenty-one reference files, no bundled skill. Every code-changing command commits before the run ends; push and PR sit behind one consent choice. Depends on the companion `workflows-core` plugin alone.
